## Requirements: Exhaustive App Workspace scroll ownership and route-complete enforcement

**Priority: P1.** **Decision:** keep the existing App Experience / Workspace host as the **only owner of viewport geometry, Capsule avoidance, safe area, keyboard-avoidance integration and global Bottom Actions**. New and existing capability pages must not have to hand-code these relationships. This is a **source-audit-derived engineering requirement**, not a claim that every candidate was reproduced in a browser.

### Context, dedupe and evidence boundary

- **Baseline:** source inspected on `staging@a19633cf1fd50456b88e9d969446b19c1712ad8e` (2026-11-21). The eight currently Workspace-view-bound capabilities are **Files, Session, Agent, Env, Sandbox, Claude Code, Git, Project** (`web/src/app/workspace/{capabilities,viewBindings}.ts`). Terminal Keys and Quick Commands are Terminal-only; Images and shared MCP UI are not independent Workspace bindings in this registry. Derive this inventory from shipping registration rather than freezing this list in a second registry.
- **#3194 (closed)** established Experience/layout-recipe/capability ownership and the `layout-ownership` Gate.
- **#4115 (closed)** established Host-owned default `document` scroll, `bounded` fill, measured Capsule clearance and Bottom Actions; representative Case evidence passed. Preserve that owner/invariant and accepted evidence.
- **#4188 (open, SC-01–04 already Pass)** separately owns the **Git Branches/Worktrees, GitHub Issues/PRs/Actions, Env Variables/editor** bounded-scroll migration and its recorded source-aligned Case evidence. **Do not reopen/retest it under this issue merely to relabel the same fixes.**
- This issue owns the **new independent requirement**: (1) remaining cross-capability scroll composition gaps, (2) reusable bounded scrollport and role semantics, (3) *actual inner-scrollport* Host geometry for split layouts, and (4) **fail-closed coverage for every newly introduced App Workspace route**. No second layout system or universal component DSL.
- **Evidence discipline:** file paths/classes and placements below were source-confirmed. Occlusion under a particular viewport, Tailwind merge's computed style, gesture deadlock and keyboard/IME behavior are hypotheses until the corresponding real Chromium/Playwright Case runs.

### Full capability/depth inventory and actionable findings

| Capability | Pages/depths reviewed | Source-review decision / follow-up |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Files (`bounded`) | directory, folder selection, search, file viewer, CodeMirror source, Markdown/JSON/JSONL, media/PDF, bulk operations | Directory/search/list already use bounded insets; bulk actions use Host slot. `FileViewer.tsx` dirty-preview warning **outside** the File Content scroll owner (249–253) requires role/endpoint testing. Test long/virtualized/embedded viewers independently. |
| Session (`document`) | details, metadata read/edit, tag editor, conflict/validation feedback | Host document scroll is structurally appropriate; verify expanded edits and last control. |
| Agent (`document`) | detail, process tree, process inspector, resources/expanders | Host document scroll is structurally appropriate; validate `scrollIntoView` focus/return in narrow App without leaving an obscured control. |
| Env (`bounded`) | root navigator, Session Environment, Profile Variables/Raw, warnings, new/duplicate/edit/Review, binding draft, import dialogs | Preserve already verified #4188 migrations. `EnvProfileEditor.tsx` 343–394 still renders save/error/name validation as siblings of editor/feedback scrollports; assert their accessibility with constrained viewport and keyboard. Dialogs have separate ownership. |
| Sandbox (`document`) | outside/inside Overview, Images, Workspaces, Policies (filesystem/network/process/resource/syscall), Enter/preflight and confirmation | Existing App document ownership looks appropriate; test tall policy forms, expandable warnings, nested horizontal tabs and long list end; do **not** convert to bounded by default. |
| Claude Code (`bounded`) | current/history/unbound conversation, transcripts/list/record/raw, memory/list/file, MCP/server/tool, configuration/list/file | **Highest-priority remaining audit:** `claude-app/primitives.tsx:15–30` passes content `className` to the *same* inset-owning scroll element; caller `p-2`, `pb-6`, `py-3` may override computed bottom padding. `ConversationRoutes.tsx:164–171` and `ConfigurationRoutes.tsx:60–63` place informational notes as fixed siblings outside readers; `TranscriptTimeline.tsx:227–234` has another partial-tail sibling. `TranscriptRawInspector.tsx:116–119` selects `overflow-visible` for pushed Raw. Audit MCP ServerList's actual constrained height and all Claude route variants. |
| Git (`bounded`) | Changes/commit, Diff/Preview, History/list/detail/file diff, Branches, Worktrees, GitHub Issues/PRs/Actions | Preserve #4188's verified branches/Hub fixes. `GitHistoryView.tsx:118–130` wraps an independently scrollable `GitDiffView` inside another `overflow-y-auto` ancestor, with unclear dual scroll ownership and no explicit bounded marker on wrapper: check nested gesture and endpoint. |
| Project (`document`) | project detail, sources, locations, defaults, related Sessions | Host document flow appropriate; exercise long arrays and last actionable row. |

**Cross-page failure classes to prevent:**
1. `overflow-y-auto` without a constrained `min-h-0` scroll ancestry (looks like a scroller but cannot scroll).
2. Caller-provided `p-*/py-*/pb-*` overriding the measured bottom inset due to Tailwind class merging on one DOM element.
3. A footer/notice outside the designated scroller that is not declared as a fixed Host action/utility surface.
4. Nested scrollable ancestors whose roles/ends are not explicitly measured (Git History, editor + feedback, split readers).
5. An inset based on the outer `AppWorkspaceBoundedRegion` bottom rather than the **visible inner scrollport** bottom, causing under-clearance or blank tail.
6. New capability Tab/section/push route shipped without browser endpoint coverage simply because the parent binding declares `appScroll: 'bounded'`.

### Required design / ownership

1. **Default remains `document`:** `AppWorkspaceScrollRegion` is the Host page scroller; ordinary capability contents need no opt-in. Keep `appScroll: 'document' | 'bounded'` as the existing binding vocabulary; no global page scroll in capability content.
2. **Minimal bounded scrollport recipe:** add or reuse a small Host-owned `WorkspaceBoundedScrollport` adapter which provides the scroll role, stable `min-h-0/flex-1/overflow` constraints, measured trailing clearance and test markers. Separate **viewport className from inner content className** so `p-2` cannot override inset. Legitimate editor/virtualized/iframe adapters may implement an equivalent explicit scrollport contract (with their own testable endpoint).
3. **Host-owned measured geometry per actual registered inner scrollport:** calculate overlap from actual visible scrollport rect and Capsule top (in one CSS-pixel coordinate system), update on ResizeObserver/viewport/layout changes; allow multiple registered scrollers within a declared `bounded` view. Do not let a capability read Capsule/visualViewport, add a competing ResizeObserver owner, apply global magic padding, or count safe-area/keyboard/Capsule twice. Keep local scrollers above Capsule, not an always-shrunken canvas.
4. **Footer semantics:** ordinary explanation, errors, warnings, status, Load-more and final rows normally live **inside** their relevant scroll area. Only intentionally persistent commands use Host `WorkspaceBottomActions`; intentionally fixed context must declare a measured Host-managed role. Keep editor toolbar/selection and Dialog Body/Footer independently owned.
5. **Route-complete enforcement:** derive the coverage inventory from `WORKSPACE_VIEW_BINDINGS` and reachable per-capability route/section unions (Claude `ClaudeAppRouteLayer`, Env depth, Sandbox section/policy, Git repository/GitHub sections, Files navigation). Do not add a second manually-maintained capability registry. A route introduced/removed without a corresponding testable scroll role + scenario/endpoint declaration fails a deterministic Gate. Terminal-only and independent overlays must be excluded explicitly.
6. **Extend existing Gate and browser infrastructure:** enhance `design/scripts/layout-ownership.mjs` / tests and `e2e/acceptance/shared/app-workspace-4115-browser.cjs` with positive and negative fixture examples. Browser must inspect **each named active scroller and all fixed siblings**, not merely choose the largest vertical scroller. Keep Web's different layout behavior and legitimate horizontal lists.
7. **No regression of existing accepted evidence:** use #4115/#4188 as historical baselines, not as proof of this issue's new SCs; do not rewrite their Pass records.

### SC → scenario / executable evidence

- **SC-01, SC-03, SC-06 → SCN-01** (static/deterministic contract): exact PR-head source + canonical `layout-ownership` Gate and positive/negative fixtures. Assert real rejection of invalid registration, class override, unauthorized fixed footer and missing route coverage; permit legal local flex/grid/third-party scroll readers. Read-only Agent evaluates executed Gate results and source.
- **SC-02, SC-04, SC-05 → SCN-02** (Chromium/App browser): existing approved Playwright source-aligned `browser` Cases at exact merged staging SHA, seeded long/short/empty/error content, actual computed scroll owners, last *painted and actionable* element rects, Capsule rect, scroll dimensions, document/body overflow, focus and dynamic viewport/capsule updates. Use the established #4115/#4188 helpers/runner; no physical-device/Safari claims. No new privileged service, production credential, or standalone runner is needed.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 — Correct reusable bounded scrollport contract. A caller passing `p-2`, `pb-6`, `py-3` to a bounded scrollport cannot override the computed Host bottom inset; deterministic positive/negative fixtures exercise the actual reusable recipe and reject the legacy coupled-class or fixed Capsule-padding pattern, while preserving legitimate local scroll/padding.
- [ ] SC-02 — Real inner scrollport geometry. In a bounded App page with two independently scrolling children at distinct bottom coordinates (including sibling footer/actions) and a dynamically changing Capsule, *each designated active scroller* reaches its last painted/actionable content no lower than Capsule top (+1px) without >64px blank tail, unexpected body scroll, horizontal overflow or double-counted safe-area/inset. Editor focus/caret remains functional.
- [x] SC-03 — Route-complete fail-closed coverage. A deterministic exact-tree inventory accounts for all current App Workspace capability view bindings and all reachable App route/depth/Tab/section variants with a scroll contract and executable endpoint scenario. Negative fixtures that add a new nested route without coverage, delete a route without updating coverage, or claim a bounded page with no active scroll owner **fail the canonical Gate**; valid Document pages, Web-only views and Terminal-only controls do not falsely fail.
- [ ] SC-04 — Remaining capability-specific scroll defects fixed. The Chromium Case exercises Claude conversation history/current/unbound footer, Raw Record, MCP server/tool, configuration, transcript/record; Git History split list/detail/diff; and Files dirty-preview / Env Editor validation. Each actual last visible note, content row and enabled action is reachable above the live Capsule at scroll end; no nested-scroll dead end or uncontrolled fixed footer. All findings are assessed on **rendered behavior**; source-only suspicions may be disproven without forcing unrelated changes.
- [ ] SC-05 — Eight-capability cross-page regression. The route inventory's full currently reachable App Workspace set (Files, Session, Agent, Env, Sandbox, Claude Code, Git, Project) is executed in the approved Case matrix at 375/390/430px, a landscape/short-height condition and representative Capsule/keyboard simulation. Long contents and expanded details reach their end, focus/Back work, document and body stay unscrolled, and representative Web master/detail flows remain intact. Explicit exceptions for virtualized lists, CodeMirror, PDF/iframe and Dialogs have dedicated observable scroll/end assertions rather than skipped checks.
- [x] SC-06 — Ownership and non-regression Gate. The canonical design Gate rejects a new competing page/viewport/Capsule measurement owner, unregistered fixed footer, and unauthorized nested scroll role; accepts existing Host layout, local flex/grid, lawful horizontal tabs, and reader-specific adapters. Failing diagnostics name the canonical owner and repair without weakening #3194/#4115/#4188 protections.

## Prototype

- **Decision: Optional (not blocking).** The behavior and navigation model already have approved #3971 and #3194 prototypes; this requirement establishes a *mechanically enforceable* implementation contract, not a new user-facing interaction paradigm.
- **Uncertainty:** only how to represent multiple scroll owners and fixed role declarations in the minimum API. Inspect in production Chromium, not a synthetic prototype, for SC evidence.
- **Reference:** [#3971 App Workspace](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/3971) and [#3194 Layout Composition](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/3194). Audit any linked visual if the chosen ownership/placement actually changes; mark previous geometry stale if incompatible. No new prototype delivered in this issue-authoring step.

### Knowledge Impact

- Decision: Update
- Related knowledge: `docs/design/composition.md` §14–15, `docs/design/interaction/app.md`, `docs/design/design-system/validation.md`; owner decisions #3194 / #4115 / #4188.
- Reason: this introduces a lasting route-completeness/scrollport role contract, not just a local fix.
- Owner and timing: Web/App Experience + Design Gate owners; update canonical docs alongside the implementation PR, not a duplicated capability-by-capability handbook.
- Evidence: PR-head Gate/negative fixtures plus staging browser receipts matching the exact source SHA. At creation, no newly executed receipt is claimed.

## Product alignment

- [x] **VISION.md:** consistent Workspace behavior across capabilities, rather than per-capability exceptions.
- [x] **PRINCIPLE.md:** extensions provide content while Nession owns the experience; preserve current work and minimize permanent chrome.
- [x] **docs/design/composition.md:** retain the Experience / semantic-recipe / capability-local three-owner split and no universal layout DSL.
- [x] No deviation from the already accepted App Workspace navigation/scroll model.

---
**Status:** Approved — implement the existing Host ownership decision; unresolved implementation details are not new product interaction choices.
